name: Top 10 Pi Agent Extensions Every Developers Must Install | Composio
description: The core gives the model exactly four tools. read, write, edit, and bash. That’s it. Everything else comes from packages you install yourself. This sounds a bit too weird or limiting, whatever you wanna call it, but only till you realise the pi.dev catalogue already has 5,000+ packages.
